question: Kanch Mahal is located in which of the following districts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kanch Mahal is situated close to **Akbar’s tomb** in **Sikandra (Agra district).**
 
• **Built by Jahangir** and was used as a royal **hunting lodge.**
 
• The **square-shaped** Kanch Mahal is a testimony to the best features of domestic Mughal architecture.
 
• Records show that the Mahal was built from **1605 to 1619.**
 
• It is called Kanch Mahal because of the** abundant use of tile work in its construction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Akbar's Tomb__ - It is situated on the outskirts of Agra City.

 
 
• Location - Sikandra, a suburb of Agra.
 
• It houses the mortal remains of the Mughal Emperor Akbar, who during his lifetime had completed the tomb and laid out a beautiful garden.
 
• The topmost portion of the tomb in marble was constructed by his son, Jahangir.
 
• The shape of the tomb is pyramidal and consists of five storeys.
